title: Transmission lines · RTE · region
description: Kilometers of RTE transmission line in operation inside each region of mainland France by voltage band, their sum, the highest voltage present, and whether the region has any line. Lengths are measured inside the region; a line that crosses a boundary is counted only for the part inside. The line geometry dates from 30 June 2023.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name from the boundaries release; where it differs from the official geographic code, the official spelling is used (see verification.method).

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: coverage_note
fields.description: Reason why the unit is not_covered, in English; empty for covered units.

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every not_covered unit has a reason in this field.
null_meaning.covered: The unit is covered, so there is no reason to give.

fields.name: km_total
fields.description: Sum of the band columns: length of line in operation inside the region, km.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_lt100
fields.description: Length of line below 100 kV (90, 63, 45 kV and below), km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_100_199
fields.description: Length of line from 100 to 199 kV (150 kV in this network), km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_200_299
fields.description: Length of line from 200 to 299 kV (225 kV in this network), km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_300_399
fields.description: Length of line from 300 to 399 kV, km. The RTE network has no line in this band; the column keeps the bands common to all transmission layers of the project.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_400_599
fields.description: Length of line from 400 to 599 kV (400 kV in this network), km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_ge600
fields.description: Length of line of 600 kV and above, km. The RTE network has no line in this band; the column keeps the bands common to all transmission layers of the project.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_dc
fields.description: Length of direct-current line, km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: km_unknown
fields.description: Length of line without a usable voltage, mostly lines recorded as de-energized (hors tension), km. 0 means none.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: max_voltage_kv
fields.description: Highest voltage among the lines inside the region that have a recorded voltage.

null_meaning.covered: The region has no line with a recorded voltage.
null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: has_any_line
fields.description: True if at least one line of the source touches the region.

null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

fields.name: frac_km_unknown_voltage
fields.description: Share of the line length inside the region without a usable voltage, from 0 to 1.

null_meaning.covered: The region has no line length inside it, so the share is undefined.
null_meaning.not_covered: The RTE transmission network covers mainland France; Corsica and the overseas regions have separate grids that are not in this source.

coverage.geography: 12 continental regions; Corse (94) and the five overseas regions not covered
known_gaps: The line geometry dates from 30 June 2023 (a public copy republished by DDTM de l'Eure). Since June 2026 RTE publishes its list of lines on ODRÉ without coordinates, citing public security: "RTE a fait évoluer l'accès aux données GPS des infrastructures du réseau public de transport pour des raisons de sécurité publique" (ODRÉ, Lignes aériennes RTE, https://odre.opendatasoft.com/explore/dataset/lignes-aeriennes-rte-nv/). The project therefore publishes only region and department totals and does not publish line segments.
Substations are not included: the project does not collect their locations.
Lines with an administrative approval that are not yet built (état ACCORD ADMINISTRATIF; 159 segments, 1,467.5 km) are not included.
Lines recorded as de-energized (hors tension; 1,882 km) are counted in km_unknown, without a voltage.

Regions are merged from the Natural Earth 1:10m department outlines used by the department layer, so region values equal the sum of their department values. A line within about a kilometer of a region boundary may be counted in the neighboring region. 793.5 km of line lie outside the 12 covered regions (coast and international connections) and are not counted.
The layer does not show how much power can flow into a region.

verification.method: Line lengths inside each region are computed by script from the line geometry of the source and classed by voltage, with the same rules as the department layer; frac_km_unknown_voltage is computed from kilometers, not averaged over departments. Region totals were checked against the sum of the department totals. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build. 3 unit names corrected from Natural Earth spelling to the INSEE official geographic code.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 18 FRA ADM1 units of the boundaries release; 12 are covered and 6 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.
km_total > 0 exactly when has_any_line was tested for every covered unit; 0 divergences (lines shorter than rounding) are listed in the release report.
